overview:
**Fire danger is Moderate today across the Montrose (High Elevation) area, driven by low minimum humidity and steady drying fuels.**

- Danger trends upward through the week, reaching High by Thursday, Oct. 9, as ERC and BI percentiles climb into the mid-60s.
- Light NNE winds and no measurable rain are expected all 7 days, keeping fuels on a slow drying trend.
- One of seven local watchout thresholds is tripped today: minimum relative humidity hit 21%, below the local trigger.
- No Red Flag Warning is active; NWS calls for sunny skies today with a high near 75°F.
- Stage 1 Fire Restrictions remain in effect in unincorporated Montrose County, effective since September 4, 2026. Ouray County reinstated Stage 1 restrictions on September 3, 2026.
- The Gold Mountain Fire near Ouray was 92% contained by late August and is now in long-term recovery, with no active uncontained wildfires reported near this area today.
